messages.author: e5563c64d65403a1
messages.subject: 24/7 dashboard without idle disconnect?
parts:
Hi all,

I'm looking into running a flexdashboard within a room on constant uptime (except for unforeseen events like network outages etc.) using shinyapps.
I was hoping someone had the settings that I could use to maintain an idle dashboard indefinitely without time out / disconnect.

Active hours won't be a problem.

Thanks,
Scott G.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: 24/7 dashboard without idle disconnect?
parts: See Section 3.7.1.5 Read Timeout in the documentation, setting it to 0 should have the effect you are looking for.
